**Implementation note:** Gap-analysis lead: Nasdaq-100 futures to ETF lead-lag (Hayashi-Yoshida).

## Description

Uses a lagged relationship between a leading market/instrument and a slower-responding related instrument to predict near-term direction or fair value.

## Where it may fit

Markets with measurable information transmission and sufficient latency separation; may disappear as participants adapt.

## Vehicles

Index futures/ETFs, ADR/local shares, related commodities, FX pairs, liquid crypto venues.

## Required data

Synchronized timestamped trades/quotes, time-zone/session alignment, latency and transaction-cost data.

## Caveats

Must eliminate timestamp leakage and account for latency, stale quotes, market impact and venue fees.
